# kcore_node_install (Resource)

Install kcore onto a node that is booted from the ISO (`kctl node install`). This wipes os_disk. Destroy only drops the Terraform state; it does not roll the install back.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Live installer address. Port defaults to 9091.
- `certs_dir` (String) Directory produced by kcore_cluster.
- `os_disk` (String)

### Optional

- `data_disk` (List of String)
- `dc_id` (String)
- `disable_vxlan` (Boolean)
- `hostname` (String)
- `insecure` (Boolean) Dial the live installer without TLS. The ISO agent has no cluster certificate yet.
- `join_controller` (String) Controller host:9090 to join. Required unless run_controller is true.
- `node_id` (String)
- `run_controller` (Boolean)
- `storage_backend` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `luks_method` (String)
- `message` (String)
